name: Lobby — clicking available island opens detail panel with Learn/Lab/Quiz buttons

planSteps.description: The heading 'แผนที่โลกฟิสิกส์' is visible
Click the first island that is NOT labeled 'ล็อค' (find the first available/unlocked island)
A detail panel slides open showing the island's name
A button containing text 'Learn' is visible in the detail panel
A button containing text 'Lab' is visible in the detail panel
A button containing text 'Quiz' is visible in the detail panel
